title: Discovering Heron's Triangle Area Formula in a Morning in the Rain
summary: Motivations and derivations for Heron's triangle area formula abound. But how would one \emph{discover} the formula? We recount the challenge of designing a laboratory experiment to discover Heron's formula, and of doing so in the morning, in time for a noon class---a snapshot of collaboration with AI in fall 2025. We then reflect on extensions and generalizations.
